summary: TriLinc Global Impact Fund LLC filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 for a routine portfolio update as of March 31, 2026. The filing reports portfolio assets of approximately $283 million, a weighted average loan size of about $10 million, and a weighted average duration of 0.4 years. It discloses aggregate investments of $1.210 billion to 103 borrowers, with $904.6 million in repayments. No special situation event—merger, tender, activist, restructuring, or similar—is referenced. This is a standard operational update, not a special-situation filing. There is no deal, recommendation, or structural change to analyze.
